concept.en: A sub-audible tone opens the receiver

summary.hr: Stanice odašilju s tonom i bez njega. Detektor skuplja 0,5 s zvuka i traži postavljeni ton 12 dB iznad ostalih; tek tada se zvučnik otvara.
summary.en: Stations key up with and without a tone. The detector collects 0.5 s of audio and looks for the set tone 12 dB above the rest; only then does the speaker open.

concept.hr: Detektoru treba 0,5 s: zvučnik se otvara tek tada, prvih pola sekunde se gubi
concept.en: The detector needs 0.5 s: the speaker opens only then, losing the first 0.5 s

concept.hr: Bez tona tonska brava ostaje zatvorena; brava po nositelju otvara se odmah
concept.en: Without a tone, tone squelch stays shut; carrier squelch opens at once

concept.hr: 91,5 Hz je prepoznat, ali nije postavljenih 88,5 Hz: zvučnik ostaje zatvoren
concept.en: 91.5 Hz is detected, but it is not the set 88.5 Hz: the speaker stays muted

concept.hr: Stanica bez tona se ne čuje, a ipak duplira: CTCSS ne čini kanal privatnim
concept.en: A station without the tone goes unheard, yet still doubles: CTCSS is not privacy

what.hr: Šumna brava, prag i dupliranje (tekst, sažeto i prerađeno)
what.en: Squelch, threshold and doubling (text, summarised and adapted)

changes.hr: Odjeljci squelch, squelch_2 i relaisfunkstellen (hrvatski prijevod) sažeti u objašnjenje i pravila modela; ništa nije preuzeto doslovno
changes.en: The squelch, squelch_2 and relaisfunkstellen sections (Croatian translation) summarised into the explanation and the model's rules; nothing is copied verbatim
